In view of road cutting work for laying of sewerage pipeline (40 mm diameter RCC NP4) near Dr. Agarwal Eye Hospital, Panjagutta, traffic congestion is expected in the surrounding areas of Panjagutta and Ameerpet from  19-04-2026 to 25-04-2026, between 23:00 hrs and 04:00 hrs.

The general public are advised to avoid the routes between Ameerpet and Panjagutta (both directions). Traffic congestion is also likely on the surrounding roads connecting Ameerpet and Panjagutta.
Commuters are appealed to follow traffic updates on our social media platform @ Hyderabad Traffic Police face book page (https://t.co/RMgFu4rSW3) and @ HYDTP (Twitter handle). In case of any emergency in travel, kindly call our traffic help line 9010203626 for travel assistance.
All citizens are requested to make note of the above traffic congestion, take alternate routes to reach your destinations and cooperate with the Hyderabad Traffic Police.

(D. JOEL DAVIS, IPS.,)
Jt. Commissioner of Police,
Traffic, Hyderabad
